subject: classical-civilisation-ocr
title: Foundation Myths: Athens & Rome
reason: The video incorrectly attributes the founding of Alba Longa to Aeneas instead of his son Ascanius (Aeneas founded Lavinium), which would cost marks on foundation sequence questions in GCSE Classical Civilisation.

mark_affecting.quote: Aeneas flees west, and eventually founds a settlement in Italy called Alba Longa.
